newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 10-yr bond yields seen rising in low demand.
newsitem.headline: Polish 10-yr bond yields seen rising in low demand.

text.p: Polish 10-year floating rate bond yields are expected to rise following an increase in market rates over the last month, but demand is seen low at Tuesday's 600 million zloty primary auction, dealers said.

"A larger discount could be seen tomorrow as banks will bid for lower prices. But it will all depend on how far will (Finance Minister Grzegorz) Kolodko allow them to drop," said one dealer at a major Polish bank.
Dealers said that demand would likely fall well short of the offer as banks were not interested in bonds of such length with relatively low liquidity.
They said banks would likely bid at various prices down to about 99.00, against the last minimum price of 99.53 and 99.62 average price on December 10, 1996.
